questionText:
Three of the five students allocated to a hostel put in special requests to the warden. Given the floor plan of the vacant rooms, select the allocation plan that will accommodate all their requests.

Request by X: Due to pollen allergy, I want to avoid a wing next to the garden.
Request by Y: I want to live as far from the washrooms as possible, since I am very sensitive to smell.
Request by Z: I believe in Vaastu and so want to stay in the South-west wing.
The shaded rooms are already occupied. WR is washroom.
explanation:
Step-by-step Evaluation:

1. Request by Z: Z wants to stay in the South-west wing (bottom-left area).
- In Option (A) and (B), Z is in the West (middle-left) wing.
- In Option (C), Z is in the North-East wing.
- In Option (D), Z is located in the South-west (bottom) wing.
Thus, only Option (D) satisfies Z's request.

2. Request by X: X wants to avoid the garden (located along the East/right side). In Option (D), X is in the bottom-left wing, far from the garden.

3. Request by Y: Y wants to be as far as possible from the washrooms (WR), which are located at the top-left and bottom-left corners. In Option (D), Y is placed in the middle-right room, which maximizes the distance from both washrooms.

Therefore, Option (D) satisfies all three student requests.
